review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: Rigorous mathematical framework for emergent collective Hamiltonians from microscopic dynamics. Current kinetic theory provides equations of motion but not a systematic Hamiltonian formulation of collective phenomena. Need: (1) Precise characterization of resonance conditions in general phase spaces, (2) Construction of effective Hamiltonians for collective modes that captures non-additive dynamics, (3) Rigorous proof of critical density thresholds for collective behavior.
